title: CAREER RAIDS: THE KILL SCORE
why: His mode design of 2026-10-12: in CAREER the high score is still an objective, and his rule that the scoring is exactly the same in DEMO and CAREER. A kill in a CAREER raid now scores as it does in the DEMO: the same points for each kind, the same streak multiplier and callouts, and the +$ popup where the body fell. Each player in a co-op raid scores his own kills. The score sits at the top of the screen with the 10 minute clock under it, as in the DEMO. The DEMO helping hands (ammo back and free bandages on kills) stay in the DEMO.
now: Kills in CAREER raids score points, with streaks, shown above the clock.
